items.title: Muse Spark Open model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Meta's Muse Spark Open is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: AWS Introduces Strands Decider 2B and Strands Box for AI Agent Development
items.blurb: AWS has introduced two open-source projects for AI agent development: Strands Decider 2B, a small model designed to make decisions within agent workflows, and Strands Box, a sandbox for controlling agent execution.

items.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports AWS Lambda Web Functions as an origin
items.blurb: Starting today, you can deliver web applications built on AWS Lambda Web Functions through CloudFront's global edge network.

items.title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore expands to AWS GovCloud and 3 Regions
items.blurb: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now available in four additional AWS Regions: US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Sydney), and AWS GovCloud (US-West).

items.title: Amazon EC2 T8i instances are now available in South America (São Paulo)
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) T8i instances are now available in South America (São Paulo).

items.title: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports timestamp-based stream processing
items.blurb: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports timestamp-based stream processing, enabling you to begin reading stream records from a specific point in time.

items.title: AWS Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Go is now generally available
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of the AWS Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Go, enabling Go developers to build resilient, long-running workflows using Lambda durable functions.

items.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports shared VPCs
items.blurb: AWS HealthOmics now supports sharing VPCs across accounts, enabling your workflows to access resources in Amazon Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) managed by other AWS accounts with AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM).
